judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the acceptance tests and updating the spec, completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the production code was never modified, all three newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` will fail when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria and its own definition of done, and left an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository. On the positive side, the updated spec in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the structure of the acceptance tests accurately capture the intended behavior.
